class TestVocab(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sizes_and_uniqueness(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(vocab.ATOMS), 64)
        self.assertEqual(len(set(vocab.ATOMS)), 64)
        self.assertEqual(len(vocab.RESPONSES), 64)
        self.assertTrue(set(vocab.ALIASES) <= set(vocab.ATOMS))

    def test_label_words_are_not_atoms(self):
        # метки (cozy/inviting/warm/comfortable) не должны быть атомами, иначе матрица «предсказывает слово словом»
        for w in ("cozy", "inviting", "warm", "comfortable", "relaxing"):
            self.assertNotIn(w, vocab.ATOMS)

    def test_old_pipeline_bug_vocab_not_silently_truncated(self):
        # прежний build_dataset.attributes() молча отбрасывал 10 из 74 атомов (в т.ч. 'cozy'); здесь словарь обязан быть ровно 64
        self.assertEqual(sum(len(g) for g in vocab.ATOM_GROUPS.values()), 64)

    def test_rug_and_carpet_floor_are_separate(self):
        self.assertIn("rug", vocab.ATOMS)
        self.assertIn("carpet_floor", vocab.ATOMS)


class TestParser(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_negation(self):
        r = parse_text("The room has no rug and is not cluttered.")["presence"]
        self.assertEqual(r.get("rug"), 0)
        self.assertEqual(r.get("cluttered"), 0)

    def test_warmth_is_not_a_palette(self):
        # прежний парсер: «adding warmth» -> warm_palette
        r = parse_text("The bed adds warmth to the room.")
        self.assertNotIn("warm_palette", r["presence"])
        self.assertEqual(r["responses"]["warm_kw"], 1.0)

    def test_specific_beats_generic(self):
        p = parse_text("A coffee table and a dining table.")["presence"]
        self.assertEqual(p.get("coffee_table"), 1)
        p2 = parse_text("A coffee table in front of the sofa.")["presence"]
        self.assertNotIn("table", p2)

    def test_carpeted_floor_is_not_a_rug(self):
        p = parse_text("A carpeted floor in an office.")["presence"]
        self.assertEqual(p.get("carpet_floor"), 1)
        self.assertNotIn("rug", p)
        self.assertEqual(parse_text("A patterned rug under the bed.")["presence"].get("rug"), 1)

    def test_unmentioned_is_not_listed(self):
        p = parse_text("A wooden desk.")["presence"]
        self.assertNotIn("sofa", p)

    def test_label_leakage_absent_from_atoms(self):
        p = parse_text("A cozy, inviting, warm and comfortable room.")["presence"]
        self.assertEqual(p, {})


class TestSceneStore(unittest.TestCase):
    def _store(self):
        s = SceneStore()
        s.add_from_text("a", "A cozy bedroom with a bed and a blanket.")
        s.add_from_text("b", "An office with a desk and a chair. Not cluttered.")
        return s

    def test_old_bug_all_attributes_active_and_search_broken(self):
        s = self._store()
        g = s.get_scene("a")
        self.assertIn("bed", g["present"])
        self.assertLess(len(g["present"]), 10)            # у прежнего хранилища было 64
        self.assertEqual(s.find(has=["sofa"]), [])        # у прежнего вернулись обе сцены
        self.assertEqual({h["scene_id"] for h in s.find(has=["bed"])}, {"a"})
        self.assertEqual({h["scene_id"] for h in s.find(not_has=["bed"])}, {"b"})

    def test_three_state_presence(self):
        s = self._store()
        i = s._idx["b"]
        self.assertEqual(s.presence[i, vocab.ATOM_INDEX["desk"]], PRESENT)
        self.assertEqual(s.presence[i, vocab.ATOM_INDEX["cluttered"]], ABSENT)
        self.assertEqual(s.presence[i, vocab.ATOM_INDEX["sofa"]], UNKNOWN)
        self.assertEqual({h["scene_id"] for h in s.find(not_has=["cluttered"], strict_absent=True)}, {"b"})

    def test_responses_do_not_overwrite_atoms(self):
        s = self._store()
        i = s._idx["a"]
        before = s.presence[i].copy()
        s.set_responses("a", {"cozy_human": 0.9})
        self.assertTrue(np.array_equal(before, s.presence[i]))

    def test_duplicate_and_unknown(self):
        s = self._store()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            s.add_from_text("a", "again")
        s.add_scene("c", {"unicorn": 1, "bed": 1}, {"nonexistent": 1.0, "cozy_kw": 1.0})
        self.assertEqual(s.meta["c"]["ignored_atoms"], ["unicorn"])
        self.assertEqual(s.meta["c"]["ignored_responses"], ["nonexistent"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            s.add_scene("d", {"bed": 2})

    def test_save_load_roundtrip(self):
        s = self._store()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            p = Path(d) / "s.npz"
            s.save(p)
            s2 = SceneStore.load(p)
            self.assertEqual(s2.scene_ids, s.scene_ids)
            self.assertEqual(s2.meta["a"]["prompt"], s.meta["a"]["prompt"])
            self.assertTrue(np.array_equal(s2.presence[:2], s.presence[:2]))
            self.assertEqual(s2._idx, s._idx)

    def test_scales_beyond_64_scenes_fast(self):
        s = SceneStore()
        t = time.time()
        for i in range(6000):
            s.add_scene(f"s{i}", {"bed": 1}, {"cozy_kw": float(i % 2)})
        self.assertEqual(len(s), 6000)
        self.assertLess(time.time() - t, 20)   # O(n^2)-поиск индекса на 132 тыс. сцен не укладывался бы в разумное время
        self.assertEqual(s.get_scene("s5999")["responses"]["cozy_kw"], 1.0)


def _synthetic_store():
    """Игрушечный корпус с известной структурой: в гостиных диван повышает долю cozy_kw, в офисах доля мала."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    s = SceneStore()
    for scan in range(40):
        room = "living_room" if scan % 2 == 0 else "office"
        for f in range(10):
            has_sofa = rng.random() < 0.5
            p_cozy = (0.7 if has_sofa else 0.2) if room == "living_room" else 0.03
            pres = {room: 1}
            if has_sofa:
                pres["sofa"] = 1
            s.add_scene(f"scan{scan:03d}/{f}", pres, {"cozy_kw": float(rng.random() < p_cozy)}, meta={"scan_id": f"scan{scan:03d}"})
    return s


class TestMatrix(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.s = _synthetic_store()
        cls.m = CozyMatrix().rebuild(cls.s)

    def test_rebuild_equals_incremental(self):
        m2 = CozyMatrix()
        w = scan_weights(self.s)
        for i in range(len(self.s)):
            m2.update(self.s.presence[i], self.s.responses[i], self.s.rmask[i], float(w[i]))
        self.assertTrue(np.allclose(m2.S, self.m.S))
        self.assertTrue(np.allclose(m2.NW, self.m.NW))

    def test_scan_weighting_counts_rooms_not_frames(self):
        c = self.m.cell("living_room", "living_room", "cozy_kw")
        self.assertEqual(c["n_frames"], 200)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(c["n_eff_scans"], 20.0, places=3)

    def test_within_room_lift_recovers_planted_effect(self):
        top = self.m.lifts_within("living_room", "cozy_kw", group="object", min_support=3)
        self.assertEqual(top[0]["a"], "sofa")
        self.assertGreater(top[0]["lift_within_context"], 0.1)

    def test_shrinkage_protects_tiny_support(self):
        s = SceneStore()
        for i in range(30):
            s.add_scene(f"x{i}", {"bed": 1}, {"cozy_kw": 0.0}, meta={"scan_id": f"sc{i}"})
        s.add_scene("lone", {"candle": 1, "bed": 1}, {"cozy_kw": 1.0}, meta={"scan_id": "solo"})
        m = CozyMatrix().rebuild(s)
        c = m.cell("candle", "candle", "cozy_kw")
        self.assertEqual(c["mean"], 1.0)
        self.assertLess(c["estimate"], 0.3)          # 1 сцена не даёт «100% уюта»
        self.assertEqual(m.partners("bed", "cozy_kw", min_support=3), [])

    def test_save_load(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            p = Path(d) / "m.npz"
            self.m.info = {"x": 1}
            self.m.save(p)
            m2 = CozyMatrix.load(p)
            self.assertTrue(np.allclose(m2.SW, self.m.SW))
            self.assertEqual(m2.info["x"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(m2.info["vocab_version"], vocab.VOCAB_VERSION)


@unittest.skipUnless(HAVE_COLOR, "нет color-matrix-full-rgb-v11.npz")
class TestColors(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.link = ColorLink(FullRGBMatrixReader(V11))

    def test_extract(self):
        ph = [p for p, _ in extract_phrases("A dark blue blanket and a beige carpet; wooden desk; light brown chair; dark blue again")]
        self.assertEqual(ph, ["dark blue", "beige", "light brown"])

    def test_modifiers_move_lightness(self):
        self.assertLess(self.link.profile("dark blue").L, self.link.profile("blue").L)
        self.assertGreater(self.link.profile("light blue").L, self.link.profile("blue").L)

    def test_features_ranges_and_unknown(self):
        f, ph = self.link.features("A beige carpet, a dark blue blanket and red cushions.")
        self.assertEqual(len(ph), 3)
        for name, v in f.items():
            self.assertTrue(0.0 <= v <= 3.0, (name, v))
        for name in ("color_empathy_mean", "color_intensity_mean", "color_chroma_mean", "color_warm_fraction"):
            self.assertTrue(0.0 <= f[name] <= 1.0, name)
        f0, ph0 = self.link.features("A wooden desk by the wall.")
        self.assertEqual((f0, ph0), ({}, []))    # цветов нет -> значения НЕИЗВЕСТНЫ, не нули

    def test_ingest_marks_color_source_and_leaves_unknown(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            p = Path(d) / "c.json"
            p.write_text(json.dumps({"scene0001_00/color/1.jpg": "A cozy room with a beige carpet and a sofa.",
                                     "scene0001_00/color/2.jpg": "A plain office with a desk."}), encoding="utf-8")
            s = SceneStore()
            rep = ingest.ingest_captions(p, s, self.link, progress_every=0)
            self.assertEqual(rep, {"ingested": 2, "scans": 1})
            j = vocab.RESPONSE_INDEX["color_n_colors"]
            self.assertEqual(int(s.rmask[0, j]), 1)
            self.assertEqual(int(s.rmask[1, j]), 0)
            self.assertEqual(s.meta["scene0001_00/1"]["label_source"]["color"], "color_matrix_prior")
            self.assertEqual(s.meta["__corpus__"]["color_matrix_version"], "prior-v11")

    def test_split_path(self):
        self.assertEqual(ingest.split_path("scene0385_02/color/1020.jpg"), ("scene0385_02", "1020"))


class TestSurveySample(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_one_frame_per_scan_deterministic_and_caption_free(self):
        s = SceneStore()
        rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
        for scan in range(30):
            room = ["living_room", "office"][scan % 2]
            for f in range(8):
                s.add_scene(f"scan{scan:03d}/{f}", {room: 1}, {"cozy_kw": float(rng.random() < 0.4)},
                            meta={"scan_id": f"scan{scan:03d}", "image_path": f"scan{scan:03d}/color/{f}.jpg", "prompt": "SECRET"})
        a, b = ingest.survey_sample(s, n=20, seed=3), ingest.survey_sample(s, n=20, seed=3)
        self.assertEqual(a, b)
        self.assertLessEqual(len(a), 20)
        self.assertEqual(len({r["scan_id"] for r in a}), len(a))      # не более одного кадра на скан
        self.assertTrue(all("prompt" not in r and "SECRET" not in json.dumps(r) for r in a))
        self.assertTrue({r["room"] for r in a} <= {"living_room", "office"})


class TestRatings(unittest.TestCase):
    def _csv(self, rows):
        d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        p = Path(d) / "r.csv"
        with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
            w = csv.writer(f)
            w.writerow(["scene_id", "rater_id", "item", "value", "scale_min", "scale_max", "probe"])
            w.writerows(rows)
        return p

    def test_validation_and_normalisation(self):
        s = SceneStore()
        s.add_from_text("a", "A bedroom.")
        rows = [("a", "r1", "cozy", 7, 0, 7, ""), ("a", "r2", "cozy", 9, 0, 7, ""), ("zzz", "r3", "cozy", 3, 0, 7, ""),
                ("a", "r4", "funky", 3, 0, 7, ""), ("a", "r5", "cozy", 3.5, 0, 7, "")]
        rep = ingest.ingest_ratings(s, self._csv(rows))
        self.assertEqual((rep["rows_added"], rep["rows_rejected"]), (2, 3))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(float(s.rt_value[1]), 0.5)

    def test_failed_probe_excludes_rater_and_min_raters(self):
        s = SceneStore()
        s.add_from_text("a", "A bedroom.")
        rows = [("a", f"r{i}", "cozy", 6, 0, 7, "") for i in range(5)] + [("a", "bad", "cozy", 0, 0, 7, ""), ("a", "bad", "cozy", 0, 0, 7, 0)]
        ingest.ingest_ratings(s, self._csv(rows))
        self.assertEqual(s.recompute_human(min_raters=5)["raters_excluded"], 1)
        j = vocab.RESPONSE_INDEX["cozy_human"]
        self.assertAlmostEqual(float(s.responses[0, j]), 6 / 7, places=5)   # плохой оценщик не повлиял
        self.assertEqual(s.recompute_human(min_raters=6)["scenes_below_min_raters"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(int(s.rmask[0, j]), 0)


class TestPrimitives(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_recipes_consistent(self):
        self.assertEqual(primitives.validate_recipes(), [])

    def test_every_object_has_recipe(self):
        self.assertEqual(set(primitives.atoms_with_recipes()), set(vocab.OBJECTS))

    def test_known_sizes(self):
        self.assertEqual(primitives.RECIPES["sofa"].size, (2.0, 0.85, 0.9))
        self.assertEqual(primitives.RECIPES["bed"].size, (1.6, 1.1, 2.1))

    def test_instantiate_rotation_scale_elevation(self):
        parts = primitives.instantiate("ottoman", x=1.0, z=2.0, rotation_y_deg=90, scale=2.0, colors={"upholstery": "#aa5533"})
        top = next(p for p in parts if p["part"] == "top")
        self.assertEqual(top["color"], "#aa5533")
        self.assertEqual(top["size"], [1.0, 0.6, 1.0])
        self.assertEqual(top["pos"], [1.0, 0.5, 2.0])
        leg = next(p for p in parts if p["part"] == "leg3")     # локально (+0.2, ., +0.2) * 2 -> после поворота на 90°
        self.assertAlmostEqual(leg["pos"][0], 1.0 + 0.4, places=3)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(leg["pos"][2], 2.0 - 0.4, places=3)
        lamp = primitives.instantiate("lamp_table", elevation=0.75)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(min(p["pos"][1] - p["size"][1] / 2 for p in lamp), 0.75, places=3)
        picture = primitives.instantiate("artwork")
        self.assertAlmostEqual(min(p["pos"][1] - p["size"][1] / 2 for p in picture), 1.4, places=3)


@unittest.skipUnless(HAVE_COLOR and HAVE_DATA, "нет собранных данных (python -m cozy_engine.cli build ...)")
class TestToolbox(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.ct = ColorToolbox(FullRGBMatrixReader(V11))
        cls.cz = CozyToolbox.from_dir(DATA, cls.ct)
        cls.ub = UnifiedToolbox(cls.ct, cls.cz)

    def test_schemas(self):
        json.dumps(self.ub.schemas)
        self.assertEqual(len({s["function"]["name"] for s in self.ub.schemas}), len(self.ub.schemas))
        self.assertEqual({s["function"]["name"] for s in COZY_SCHEMAS}, set(self.cz._tools))

    def test_plan_structure_and_honesty(self):
        r = self.ub.dispatch("cozy_scene_plan", {"room": "living_room", "count": 6})
        self.assertNotIn("error", r)
        self.assertEqual(r["label_source"], "caption_keywords")
        self.assertIn("НЕ оценки людей", r["provenance"])
        for o in r["objects"]:
            self.assertTrue(o["recipes"])
            self.assertGreaterEqual(o["n_eff_scans"], 3)
        self.assertTrue({"door", "window"}.isdisjoint({o["object"] for o in r["objects"]}))

    def test_palette_uses_color_matrix_and_respects_hue_design(self):
        r = self.ub.dispatch("cozy_palette", {"room": "bedroom"})
        self.assertNotIn("error", r)
        self.assertEqual(set(r["roles"]), set(primitives.COLOR_MATRIX_ROLES))
        for role, v in r["roles"].items():
            self.assertTrue(v["hex"].startswith("#"))
            self.assertIn(v["empathy_label"], vocab_empathy())
        h = r["roles"]["floor"]["oklch"]["h"]
        self.assertTrue(35 <= h <= 85, h)         # прежний баг: фиолетовый пол
        self.assertEqual(set(r["slot_colors"]) , set(primitives.SLOT_ROLE))

    def test_slot_colors_feed_instantiate(self):
        pal = self.ub.dispatch("cozy_palette", {"room": "living_room"})
        res = self.ub.dispatch("instantiate_object", {"object": "sofa", "x": 1, "z": 2, "colors": pal["slot_colors"]})
        up = next(p for p in res["parts"] if p["slot"] == "upholstery")
        self.assertEqual(up["color"], pal["slot_colors"]["upholstery"])

    def test_errors_returned_not_raised(self):
        for name, args in [("cozy_scene_plan", {"room": "garage"}), ("get_primitives", {"object": "chair2"}),
                           ("cozy_evidence", {"atoms": ["a", "b", "c"]}), ("nope", {}), ("cozy_scene_plan", "{bad")]:
            self.assertIn("error", self.ub.dispatch(name, args), (name, args))

    def test_routing(self):
        self.assertIn("hex", self.ub.dispatch("describe_color", {"color": "#c08040"}))
        self.assertIn("recipes", self.ub.dispatch("get_primitives", {"object": "sofa"}))

    def test_evidence_flags_low_support(self):
        r = self.ub.dispatch("cozy_evidence", {"atoms": ["candle", "fireplace"]})
        self.assertIn("enough_support", r)

    def test_agent_loop_with_unified_toolbox(self):
        class Fake:
            def __init__(self):
                self.n = 0
                self.chat = SimpleNamespace(completions=SimpleNamespace(create=self.create))

            def create(self, model, messages, tools, **kw):
                self.n += 1
                assert any(t["function"]["name"] == "cozy_scene_plan" for t in tools)
                if self.n == 1:
                    tc = [SimpleNamespace(id="1", function=SimpleNamespace(name="cozy_scene_plan", arguments='{"room":"bedroom"}'))]
                    return SimpleNamespace(choices=[SimpleNamespace(message=SimpleNamespace(content=None, tool_calls=tc))])
                return SimpleNamespace(choices=[SimpleNamespace(message=SimpleNamespace(content="готово", tool_calls=None))])

        out = run_agent(Fake(), "glm", "уютная спальня", self.ub, system_prompt="p", tools=self.ub.schemas)
        self.assertEqual(out["text"], "готово")
        self.assertNotIn("error", out["tool_calls"][0]["result"])


def vocab_empathy():
    return ["anxiety", "tension", "neutral", "warmth", "delight"]

"""Инструменты Cozy Engine для LLM + единый набор с инструментами Color Matrix.

Разделение труда:
  Cozy Engine  -> ЧТО поставить в сцену: объекты (по ассоциациям с «уютом» в корпусе) и их примитивы (из чего собрать);
  Color Matrix -> КАКОГО ЦВЕТА: цвета, empathy, intensity, температура, контраст, дальтонизм.
Связка — материальные слоты объектов (primitives.SLOT_ROLE) <-> цветовые роли палитры (cozy_palette).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np

from . import primitives as prim
from . import vocab
from .matrix import CozyMatrix, MIN_PAIR_SUPPORT

# color_matrix_python лежит рядом (output/color_matrix_python)
from color_matrix_python.tools import TOOL_SCHEMAS as COLOR_SCHEMAS, ColorToolbox  # noqa: E402
# perf C-01: импорты colorspace на уровне модуля (раньше были в _delta — 4 dict lookup на вызов)
from color_matrix_python.colorspace import delta_e_ok, parse_color, rgb_to_oklab  # noqa: E402

ARCHITECTURE = {"door", "window"}      # не «мебель»: в рекомендации объектов не попадают
SUGGEST_GROUPS = ("object",)

PROVENANCE_COZY = ("Объекты: ассоциации в подписях GPT-4o к кадрам ScanNet (слово 'cozy' и родственные), это НЕ оценки людей и не причинные "
                   "эффекты. Lift посчитан внутри комнаты данного типа, поправка на скан (кадры одной комнаты не независимы). "
                   "Размеры примитивов — типичные бытовые, не из корпуса.")

_ROOM = {"type": "string", "enum": vocab.ROOMS, "description": "Room type from the Cozy Engine vocabulary."}

COZY_SCHEMAS: list[dict] = [
    {"type": "function", "function": {
        "name": "cozy_scene_plan",
        "description": ("One-call plan for a cozy room: ranks objects by how strongly they go with 'cozy' captions INSIDE this room type "
                        "(Cozy Engine), attaches primitive recipes for building them, and picks a palette for the material slots "
                        "with the Color Matrix (empathy/intensity/temperature + contrast checks). Use it first; then refine with the "
                        "other tools. Never present the result as human-validated: evidence is caption-based."),
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
            "room": _ROOM, "count": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 3, "maximum": 14, "default": 8},
            "avoid": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}, "description": "Object atoms to exclude."},
            "must_have": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}, "description": "Object atoms that must be included."},
            "include_parts": {"type": "boolean", "default": False, "description": "Include full part lists of every recipe."}},
            "required": ["room"]}}},
    {"type": "function", "function": {
        "name": "cozy_suggest_objects",
        "description": ("Rank objects for a room type by lift of the cozy response within that room (n_eff_scans = support in independent rooms). "
                        "Also returns atmosphere hints: lights/materials/qualities that go with cozy captions in the same room."),
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
            "room": _ROOM, "count": {"type": "integer", "default": 8}, "avoid": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
            "ascending": {"type": "boolean", "default": False, "description": "True: objects that go with NON-cozy captions (what to avoid)."}},
            "required": ["room"]}}},
    {"type": "function", "function": {
        "name": "cozy_evidence",
        "description": ("Evidence for one atom or a pair of atoms (e.g. ['sofa'] or ['sofa','rug']): frames, effective independent scans, "
                        "mean and shrunk estimate of the response, lift vs global mean. Low n_eff_scans means do not draw conclusions."),
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
            "atoms": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string", "enum": vocab.ATOMS}, "minItems": 1, "maxItems": 2}},
            "required": ["atoms"]}}},
    {"type": "function", "function": {
        "name": "get_primitives",
        "description": ("Primitive recipe (boxes/cylinders/spheres with sizes in meters, positions, axes and material slots) for an object "
                        "atom, so the object can be built without external models. Origin: floor center, +y up, front +z."),
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"object": {"type": "string", "enum": vocab.OBJECTS}}, "required": ["object"]}}},
    {"type": "function", "function": {
        "name": "instantiate_object",
        "description": "Place an object: returns its parts in world coordinates (rotation about y, scale, per-slot colors, wall/surface elevation).",
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
            "object": {"type": "string", "enum": vocab.OBJECTS}, "x": {"type": "number", "default": 0}, "z": {"type": "number", "default": 0},
            "rotation_y_deg": {"type": "number", "default": 0}, "scale": {"type": "number", "default": 1},
            "elevation": {"type": "number", "description": "Height of the object's base above the floor (m), e.g. a lamp on a table."},
            "colors": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": {"type": "string"}, "description": "{slot or role: '#hex'}"}},
            "required": ["object"]}}},
    {"type": "function", "function": {
        "name": "cozy_palette",
        "description": ("Palette for the six color roles of a cozy room (wall, floor, textile_main, textile_accent, wood, light) chosen with "
                        "the Color Matrix (warm, low-intensity, gamut-safe), plus empirical color hints from the caption corpus. "
                        "Returns slot->hex ready for instantiate_object. The six roles come from fixed design constraints, so the palette is the same for every room; `room` only selects the empirical hints."),
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"room": _ROOM}, "required": ["room"]}}},
]

# Цветовые роли -> запросы к Color Matrix (find_colors). Это эвристики дизайна «уютной» палитры, а не данные корпуса.
ROLE_QUERIES: dict[str, dict] = {
    # hue_range — OKLCH-тон в градусах (красный ~25, оранжевый ~60, жёлтый ~100). Тона заданы дизайнерски: стена/пол/дерево
    # в «земляной» зоне, иначе поиск по одним лишь эмпатии/температуре возвращал, например, фиолетовый пол.
    "wall": dict(hue_range=[40, 110], lightness_range=[0.72, 0.93], min_chroma=0.01, max_chroma=0.06, feel="warmth"),
    "floor": dict(hue_range=[35, 85], lightness_range=[0.30, 0.55], min_chroma=0.04, max_chroma=0.10),
    "textile_main": dict(feel="warmth", lightness_range=[0.40, 0.72], min_chroma=0.04, max_chroma=0.13,
                         intensity=["very_low", "low", "medium"], temperature=["warm", "hot", "neutral"]),
    "textile_accent": dict(feel="delight", lightness_range=[0.45, 0.78], min_chroma=0.08, max_chroma=0.16,
                           intensity=["low", "medium", "high"]),
    "wood": dict(hue_range=[45, 80], lightness_range=[0.32, 0.62], min_chroma=0.05, max_chroma=0.13),
    "light": dict(hue_range=[70, 105], lightness_range=[0.88, 0.97], min_chroma=0.04, max_chroma=0.16),
}
ROLE_FALLBACKS = (  # если запрос пуст: ослабляем в таком порядке
    ("intensity", None), ("feel", None), ("temperature", None), ("min_chroma", None))


class CozyToolbox:
    def __init__(self, matrix: CozyMatrix, color_toolbox: ColorToolbox, color_stats: dict | None = None):
        self.m, self.color, self.color_stats = matrix, color_toolbox, color_stats or {}
        self._tools = {"cozy_scene_plan": self.cozy_scene_plan, "cozy_suggest_objects": self.cozy_suggest_objects,
                       "cozy_evidence": self.cozy_evidence, "get_primitives": self.get_primitives,
                       "instantiate_object": self.instantiate_object, "cozy_palette": self.cozy_palette}

    @classmethod
    def from_dir(cls, data_dir: str | Path, color_toolbox: ColorToolbox) -> "CozyToolbox":
        d = Path(data_dir)
        stats = json.loads((d / "cozy_color_stats.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if (d / "cozy_color_stats.json").exists() else {}
        return cls(CozyMatrix.load(d / "cozy_matrix.npz"), color_toolbox, stats)

    # -- какой отклик считать «уютом» ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _response(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        if self.m.has_evidence("cozy_human", 200):
            return "cozy_human", "survey"
        return "cozy_kw", "caption_keywords"

    @staticmethod
    def _check_room(room: str) -> None:
        if room not in vocab.ROOMS:
            raise ValueError(f"room: неизвестное значение {room!r}; допустимо {vocab.ROOMS}")

    @staticmethod
    def _check_objects(names) -> list[str]:
        names = list(names or [])
        bad = [n for n in names if n not in vocab.OBJECTS]
        if bad:
            raise ValueError(f"неизвестные объекты {bad}; допустимо {vocab.OBJECTS}")
        return names

    def dispatch(self, name: str, arguments: str | dict | None = None) -> dict:
        try:
            args = json.loads(arguments) if isinstance(arguments, str) and arguments.strip() else (arguments or {})
            if not isinstance(args, dict):
                raise ValueError("arguments должны быть JSON-объектом")
            fn = self._tools.get(name)
            if fn is None:
                return {"error": f"неизвестный инструмент {name!r}", "available": sorted(self._tools)}
            return fn(**args)
        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
            return {"error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"}

    # -- инструменты --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def cozy_evidence(self, atoms: list[str]) -> dict:
        if not 1 <= len(atoms) <= 2:
            raise ValueError("нужен 1 или 2 атома")
        for a in atoms:
            if a not in vocab.ATOM_INDEX:
                raise ValueError(f"неизвестный атом {a!r}")
        resp, src = self._response()
        a, b = atoms[0], atoms[-1]
        c = self.m.cell(a, b, resp)
        c["label_source"] = src
        c["enough_support"] = c["n_eff_scans"] >= MIN_PAIR_SUPPORT
        c["provenance"] = PROVENANCE_COZY
        return c

    def cozy_suggest_objects(self, room: str, count: int = 8, avoid: list[str] | None = None, ascending: bool = False) -> dict:
        self._check_room(room)
        avoid = set(self._check_objects(avoid)) | ARCHITECTURE
        resp, src = self._response()
        ranked = [x for x in self.m.lifts_within(room, resp, group="object", top=64, ascending=ascending) if x["a"] not in avoid]
        if not ranked:
            return {"room": room, "error": "для этой комнаты недостаточно данных (n_eff_scans < порога)", "label_source": src}
        objs = []
        for x in ranked[:max(1, min(int(count), 20))]:
            rs = prim.recipes_for_atom(x["a"])
            objs.append({"object": x["a"], "lift_within_room": round(x["lift_within_context"], 4), "estimate": round(x["estimate"], 4),
                         "n_frames": x["n_frames"], "n_eff_scans": x["n_eff_scans"],
                         "recipes": [{"id": r.id, "size_m": list(r.size), "mount": r.mount, "tags": list(r.tags)} for r in rs]})
        room_cell = self.m.cell(room, room, resp)
        hints = {g: [{"atom": h["a"], "lift_within_room": round(h["lift_within_context"], 4), "n_eff_scans": h["n_eff_scans"]}
                     for h in self.m.lifts_within(room, resp, group=g, top=3, ascending=ascending)]
                 for g in ("light", "material", "quality")}
        return {"room": room, "response": resp, "label_source": src, "room_baseline": round(room_cell["estimate"], 4),
                "objects": objs, "atmosphere_hints": hints, "provenance": PROVENANCE_COZY}

    def get_primitives(self, object: str) -> dict:  # noqa: A002
        self._check_objects([object])
        rs = prim.recipes_for_atom(object)
        return {"object": object, "recipes": [prim.describe(r) for r in rs], "slot_roles": prim.SLOT_ROLE,
                "note": "Координаты локальные: начало в центре основания, +y вверх, лицо +z. Для настенных объектов mount_height — высота нижнего края."}

    def instantiate_object(self, object: str, x: float = 0.0, z: float = 0.0, rotation_y_deg: float = 0.0,  # noqa: A002
                           scale: float = 1.0, elevation: float | None = None, colors: dict | None = None) -> dict:
        self._check_objects([object])
        rs = prim.recipes_for_atom(object)
        parts = prim.instantiate(rs[0].id, x, z, rotation_y_deg, scale, colors, elevation)
        return {"object": object, "recipe": rs[0].id, "parts": parts}

    def cozy_palette(self, room: str) -> dict:
        self._check_room(room)
        chosen: dict[str, dict] = {}
        # perf S-02: кэш LAB-координат уже выбранных цветов.
        # Раньше для каждого кандидата × каждой роли вызывался Python-цикл с _delta
        # против already-chosen (до 6×8×5 = 240 _delta вызовов = ~720 delta_e в Python).
        # Теперь одна broadcasted delta_e_ok (8, M) в C через numpy.
        chosen_labs: list[np.ndarray] = []
        for role, q in ROLE_QUERIES.items():
            cand, used_relax = None, None
            query = dict(q)
            for relax in [None] + [r[0] for r in ROLE_FALLBACKS]:
                if relax:
                    query.pop(relax, None)
                used_relax = relax
                res = self.color.dispatch("find_colors", {**query, "count": 8, "min_delta_e": 0.03})
                if res.get("error"):
                    raise ValueError(f"{role}: {res['error']}")
                cands = res["candidates"]
                if not cands:
                    continue
                if chosen_labs:
                    # Пакетная проверка: delta_e от каждого кандидата ко всем выбранным.
                    # cand_lab shape (8, 3) → (8, 1, 3) для broadcasting
                    # chosen_lab shape (M, 3) → (1, M, 3)
                    # delta_e_ok broadcasting → (8, M), min по axis=1 → (8,) — мин. расстояние
                    cand_rgb = np.array([parse_color(c["hex"]) for c in cands], dtype=float)
                    cand_lab = rgb_to_oklab(cand_rgb)                       # (8, 3)
                    chosen_lab_arr = np.array(chosen_labs)                  # (M, 3)
                    # broadcasting: (8, 1, 3) vs (1, M, 3) → (8, M, 3) → norm axis=-1 → (8, M)
                    dists = delta_e_ok(cand_lab[:, None, :], chosen_lab_arr[None, :, :])  # (8, M)
                    min_dists = dists.min(axis=1)                            # (8,)
                    ok_mask = min_dists >= 0.05
                    if ok_mask.any():
                        # Первый подходящий кандидат (в порядке ранжирования от find_colors).
                        cand_idx = int(np.argmax(ok_mask))
                        cand = cands[cand_idx]
                else:
                    # Первый выбор — просто берём первый кандидат (проверять не с чем).
                    cand = cands[0]
                if cand:
                    break
            if cand is None:
                raise ValueError(f"не удалось подобрать цвет для роли {role!r}")
            prof = self.color.dispatch("describe_color", {"color": cand["hex"]})
            chosen[role] = {"hex": cand["hex"], "empathy": prof["empathy"]["score"], "empathy_label": prof["empathy"]["label"],
                            "intensity": prof["intensity"]["score"], "temperature": prof["synesthesia"]["temperature"]["word"],
                            "oklch": prof["oklch"], "constraint_relaxed": used_relax}
            # Сохраняем LAB для следующих ролей (broadcasting в batched delta_e).
            chosen_labs.append(rgb_to_oklab(np.array(parse_color(cand["hex"]), dtype=float)))
        slot_colors = {prim_slot: chosen[role]["hex"] for prim_slot, role in prim.SLOT_ROLE.items() if role in chosen}
        slot_colors.update({s: prim.DEFAULT_ROLE_COLORS[r] for s, r in prim.SLOT_ROLE.items() if r in prim.DEFAULT_ROLE_COLORS})
        check = self.color.dispatch("check_palette", {"colors": [v["hex"] for v in chosen.values()], "min_delta_e": 0.04})
        return {"room": room, "roles": chosen, "slot_colors": slot_colors,
                "defaults_not_from_color_matrix": sorted(prim.DEFAULT_ROLE_COLORS),
                "distinguishability_ok": check.get("distinguishability", {}).get("normal", {}).get("min_delta_e"),
                "empirical_hints": self._empirical_hints(room),
                "provenance": ("Роли wall/floor/textile_*/wood/light выбраны Color Matrix (prior-модель; запросы-эвристики 'тёплое, "
                               "малоинтенсивное'). Остальные слоты — нейтральные цвета материалов, не из матрицы. "
                               "empirical_hints — названия цветов из подписей GPT-4o, не измерения.")}

    def cozy_scene_plan(self, room: str, count: int = 8, avoid: list[str] | None = None, must_have: list[str] | None = None,
                        include_parts: bool = False) -> dict:
        must = self._check_objects(must_have)
        sug = self.cozy_suggest_objects(room, count=max(count, 3), avoid=avoid)
        if sug.get("error"):
            return sug
        objs = sug["objects"][:count]
        have = {o["object"] for o in objs}
        for m_ in must:
            if m_ not in have:
                objs.append({"object": m_, "forced": True, "recipes": [{"id": r.id, "size_m": list(r.size), "mount": r.mount,
                                                                        "tags": list(r.tags)} for r in prim.recipes_for_atom(m_)]})
        pal = self.cozy_palette(room)
        if include_parts:
            for o in objs:
                o["parts"] = [prim.describe(prim.RECIPES[r["id"]])["parts"] for r in o["recipes"]]
        return {"room": room, "objects": objs, "atmosphere_hints": sug["atmosphere_hints"], "palette": pal["roles"],
                "slot_colors": pal["slot_colors"], "empirical_color_hints": pal["empirical_hints"],
                "label_source": sug["label_source"], "how_to_build": "get_primitives/instantiate_object(object, colors=slot_colors)",
                "provenance": PROVENANCE_COZY + " " + pal["provenance"]}

    # -- вспомогательное ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # perf C-01: импорты вынесены на уровень модуля (numpy, colorspace) — раньше реимпортировались при каждом вызове
    @staticmethod
    def _delta(h1: str, h2: str) -> float:
        return float(delta_e_ok(rgb_to_oklab(np.array(parse_color(h1), dtype=float)), rgb_to_oklab(np.array(parse_color(h2), dtype=float))))

    def _empirical_hints(self, room: str) -> list[dict]:
        by_room = (self.color_stats.get("by_room") or {}).get(room, {}).get("phrases", {})
        glob = self.color_stats.get("phrases", {})
        rows = [(p, v["lift_in_room"], v["n_frames"]) for p, v in by_room.items() if p in glob and v["n_frames"] >= 200]
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: -r[1])
        return [{"phrase": p, "hex": glob[p]["hex"], "lift_in_room": l, "n_frames": n,
                 "color_matrix": glob[p]["color_matrix"]} for p, l, n in rows[:5]]


class UnifiedToolbox:
    """Единая точка входа для агента: инструменты Color Matrix + Cozy Engine. Имена не пересекаются."""

    def __init__(self, color: ColorToolbox, cozy: CozyToolbox):
        self.color, self.cozy = color, cozy
        self.schemas = COLOR_SCHEMAS + COZY_SCHEMAS
        assert len({s["function"]["name"] for s in self.schemas}) == len(self.schemas)

    def dispatch(self, name: str, arguments: str | dict | None = None) -> dict:
        target = self.cozy if name in self.cozy._tools else self.color
        return target.dispatch(name, arguments)

"""Словарь Cozy Engine: 64 атома (что есть в сцене) и 64 отклика (как сцену оценили/измерили).

Оси Cozy Matrix: [атом A, атом B, отклик R] -> 64 x 64 x 64. Значение ячейки — среднее отклика R по всем сценам,
где одновременно присутствуют A и B (диагональ A==B — сцены, где есть A). Сами сцены хранятся отдельно (scenes.py),
поэтому их число не ограничено 64.

Версия 1.2 (1.1 + разделение rug / carpet_floor: «carpeted» — напольное покрытие почти всех комнат ScanNet, а не декор;
в 1.1 оно делало rug антиуютным в спальнях). Версия 1.1: словарь сверен с корпусом scannet-captions-gpt4o (132 358 подписей). Правила отбора атомов:
  * атом должен встречаться не менее чем в ~0.15% подписей (иначе ячейки матрицы пусты) — исключение: fireplace/candle,
    они редки, но дают самый сильный сигнал «уюта» и нужны как примитивы сцены;
  * атомы «уют/тепло/уютно» (cozy, inviting, warm, comfortable...) в словарь НЕ входят: это метки (responses), иначе матрица
    «предсказывала» бы слово словом;
  * цвета не атомы: они входят через Color Matrix (colors.py, группа откликов color_*).
Мёртвые атомы черновика (velvet 32 вхождения, knit 31, wool 1, linen 0 из 132 358) заменены на table, door, cabinet, books,
которых в черновике не было, хотя они стоят в первой десятке по частоте.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re

VOCAB_VERSION = "1.2"

def _w(*words: str) -> list[str]:
    return [rf"\b{w}\b" for w in words]


ALIASES: dict[str, list[str]] = {

=== FILE: demo_intro_v61/demo_runtime.cpp (24833 bytes, 563 lines, cpp) ===
// demo_runtime.cpp — рантайм демо-интро (v53 base + v54 stats + v58 morphing_figures).
// v51-fix: WS_POPUP→WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, single-instance mutex,
//          SetForegroundWindow + WS_EX_APPWINDOW, diagnostics in render loop.
// v53: F1 toggles FPS in window title.
// v54: always-on min/max/avg FPS stats + final report in trace.log.
// v55: 6 scenes 180s (в .smt) + cozy_room_sdf.frag fix.
// v58: +morphing_figures.frag scene (crossfade 1s + 30s) → total 211s.
//
// cl /std:c++17 /EHsc /O2 demo_runtime.cpp /I. /link opengl32.lib user32.lib gdi32.lib

#define _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <GL/gl.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string>

#include "opengl_loader.h"
#include "sm_runtime.hpp"
#include "gl_executor.hpp"

static HWND g_hwnd = nullptr;
static glx::ShaderCache* g_shaders = nullptr;  // v60: for hot-reload in WndProc
static HDC g_hdc = nullptr;
static HGLRC g_hglrc = nullptr;
static bool g_running = true;
static int g_width = 1280, g_height = 720;

// v53: FPS counter (toggleable via F1, shown in window title).
static bool   g_showFPS    = false;   // F1 переключает показ FPS в заголовке окна
static int    g_fpsFrames  = 0;       // счётчик кадров с последнего обновления
static double g_fpsAccum   = 0.0;     // накопленное время с последнего обновления
static double g_fpsValue   = 0.0;     // последнее вычисленное значение FPS
static char   g_titleBuf[200];        // буфер для SetWindowTextA

// v54: статистика FPS за весь показ (накапливается всегда, независимо от F1).
static double g_fpsMin     = 0.0;     // минимальный sampled FPS
static double g_fpsMax     = 0.0;     // максимальный sampled FPS
static double g_fpsSum     = 0.0;     // сумма всех sampled FPS (для avg)
static int    g_fpsSamples = 0;       // количество sampled обновлений

// v60: Per-scene FPS tracking.
// Scenes defined by time ranges (from .smt segment boundaries).
struct SceneStat {
    const char* name;
    double start, end;
    double minFps, maxFps, sumFps;
    int samples;
};
static SceneStat g_scenes[] = {
    {"nebula",          0.0,  23.0,  999, 0, 0, 0},
    {"transition_1",   23.0,  27.0,  999, 0, 0, 0},
    {"sphere",         27.0,  48.0,  999, 0, 0, 0},
    {"transition_2",   48.0,  52.0,  999, 0, 0, 0},
    {"particle_swarm", 52.0,  73.0,  999, 0, 0, 0},
    {"transition_3",   73.0,  77.0,  999, 0, 0, 0},
    {"anxiety_mist",   77.0,  98.0,  999, 0, 0, 0},
    {"transition_4",   98.0, 102.0,  999, 0, 0, 0},
    {"morph_grid",    102.0, 123.0,  999, 0, 0, 0},
    {"transition_5",  123.0, 127.0,  999, 0, 0, 0},
    {"cozy_room",     127.0, 180.0,  999, 0, 0, 0},
    {"transition_6",  180.0, 181.0,  999, 0, 0, 0},
    {"morphing_figures",181.0,211.0,  999, 0, 0, 0},
};
static const int g_numScenes = sizeof(g_scenes) / sizeof(g_scenes[0]);

static double getTime() {
    static LARGE_INTEGER freq = {0};
    static bool init = false;
    if (!init) { QueryPerformanceFrequency(&freq); init = true; }
    LARGE_INTEGER now; QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
    return (double)now.QuadPart / (double)freq.QuadPart;
}

static void Log(const char* fmt, ...) {
    char buf[1024]; va_list args; va_start(args, fmt);
    vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, args); va_end(args);
    OutputDebugStringA(buf); OutputDebugStringA("\n");
    printf("%s\n", buf);
    static FILE* s_log = nullptr;
    if (!s_log) { s_log = fopen("trace.log", "a"); if (s_log) setvbuf(s_log, nullptr, _IONBF, 0); }
    if (s_log) fprintf(s_log, "%s\n", buf);
}

// v60: Frame capture for visual regression testing.
// Saves JPEG-quality BMP at scene boundaries + 2s.
static void captureFrame(const char* filename, int w, int h) {
    unsigned char* px = new unsigned char[w * h * 4];
    glReadPixels(0, 0, w, h, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, px);
    // Downscale to 640x360 for smaller files (half resolution).
    int sw = w / 2, sh = h / 2;
    unsigned char* small = new unsigned char[sw * sh * 3];
    for (int y = 0; y < sh; y++) {
        for (int x = 0; x < sw; x++) {
            // Average 2x2 block
            int r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
            for (int dy = 0; dy < 2; dy++) {
                for (int dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
                    int idx = ((y * 2 + dy) * w + (x * 2 + dx)) * 4;
                    r += px[idx]; g += px[idx + 1]; b += px[idx + 2];
                }
            }
            int si = (y * sw + x) * 3;
            small[si] = b / 4; small[si + 1] = g / 4; small[si + 2] = r / 4;
        }
    }
    // Write BMP at half resolution
    FILE* f = fopen(filename, "wb");
    if (!f) { delete[] px; delete[] small; return; }
    int rowSize = ((sw * 3 + 3) / 4) * 4;
    int dataSize = rowSize * sh;
    int fileSize = 54 + dataSize;
    fputc('B', f); fputc('M', f);
    fwrite(&fileSize, 4, 1, f);
    int z = 0; fwrite(&z, 4, 1, f);
    int off = 54; fwrite(&off, 4, 1, f);
    int h40 = 40; fwrite(&h40, 4, 1, f);
    fwrite(&sw, 4, 1, f); fwrite(&sh, 4, 1, f);
    short s1 = 1; fwrite(&s1, 2, 1, f);
    short s24 = 24; fwrite(&s24, 2, 1, f);
    fwrite(&z, 4, 1, f); fwrite(&dataSize, 4, 1, f);
    int dpi = 2835; fwrite(&dpi, 4, 1, f); fwrite(&dpi, 4, 1, f);
    fwrite(&z, 4, 1, f); fwrite(&z, 4, 1, f);
    for (int y = sh - 1; y >= 0; y--) {
        for (int x = 0; x < sw; x++) {
            int idx = (y * sw + x) * 3;
            fputc(small[idx], f); fputc(small[idx + 1], f); fputc(small[idx + 2], f);
        }
        for (int p = sw * 3; p < rowSize; p++) fputc(0, f);
    }
    fclose(f);
    delete[] px; delete[] small;
}

// Capture schedule: scene boundary + 2s after transition ends.
// Scene transitions end at: T=27 (s1→s2), T=52 (s2→s3), T=77 (s3→s4),
// T=102 (s4→s5), T=127 (s5→s6), T=181 (s6→s7).
// Capture 2s after: T=29, 54, 79, 104, 129, 183.
// Plus T=2 for initial scene.
static double g_captureTimes[] = {2.0, 29.0, 54.0, 79.0, 104.0, 129.0, 183.0};
static const char* g_captureNames[] = {
    "shot_nebula.bmp",
    "shot_sphere.bmp",
    "shot_particles.bmp",
    "shot_anxiety.bmp",
    "shot_morph_grid.bmp",
    "shot_cozy_room.bmp",
    "shot_morphing_figures.bmp",
};
static int g_captureIdx = 0;
static bool g_manualCapture = false;

// v60: Recording (F3 toggle) — saves every frame as PNG for ffmpeg.
static bool g_recording = false;
static int g_recordFrame = 0;

// Minimal PNG writer (no external library, ~50 lines).
static void writePNG(const char* filename, int w, int h, const unsigned char* rgba) {
    FILE* f = fopen(filename, "wb");
    if (!f) return;
    // PNG signature
    static const unsigned char sig[] = {137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10};
    fwrite(sig, 1, 8, f);
    // IHDR chunk
    unsigned char ihdr[13] = {0};
    ihdr[0] = (w >> 24) & 0xFF; ihdr[1] = (w >> 16) & 0xFF;
    ihdr[2] = (w >> 8) & 0xFF; ihdr[3] = w & 0xFF;
    ihdr[4] = (h >> 24) & 0xFF; ihdr[5] = (h >> 16) & 0xFF;
    ihdr[6] = (h >> 8) & 0xFF; ihdr[7] = h & 0xFF;
    ihdr[8] = 8;  // bit depth
    ihdr[9] = 6;  // color type: RGBA
    // CRC and chunk writing
    auto writeChunk = [&](const char* type, const unsigned char* data, int len) {
        unsigned int clen = len;
        fwrite(&clen, 4, 1, f);
        fwrite(type, 1, 4, f);
        fwrite(data, 1, len, f);
        // CRC32
        static unsigned int table[256];
        static bool init = false;
        if (!init) {
            for (unsigned int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
                unsigned int c = i;
                for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = (c & 1) ? (0xEDB88320 ^ (c >> 1)) : (c >> 1);
                table[i] = c;
            }
            init = true;
        }
        unsigned int crc = 0xFFFFFFFF;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4 + len; i++) {
            unsigned char b = (i < 4) ? type[i] : data[i - 4];
            crc = table[(crc ^ b) & 0xFF] ^ (crc >> 8);
        }
        crc ^= 0xFFFFFFFF;
        fwrite(&crc, 4, 1, f);
    };
    writeChunk("IHDR", ihdr, 13);
    // IDAT: raw pixel data with filter byte per row
    // Use stored (no compression) — zlib header + raw deflate
    int rowBytes = w * 4;
    int rawLen = (rowBytes + 1) * h;  // +1 for filter byte per row
    unsigned char* raw = new unsigned char[rawLen];
    for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        raw[y * (rowBytes + 1)] = 0;  // filter: none
        memcpy(raw + y * (rowBytes + 1) + 1, rgba + (h - 1 - y) * rowBytes, rowBytes);  // flip Y
    }
    // zlib wrapper: 2-byte header + raw deflate (stored blocks) + 4-byte adler32
    int maxBlock = 65535;
    int numBlocks = (rawLen + maxBlock - 1) / maxBlock;
    int zlibLen = 2 + numBlocks * 5 + rawLen + 4;  // header + blocks + adler32
    unsigned char* zlib = new unsigned char[zlibLen];
    int zpos = 0;
    zlib[zpos++] = 0x78; zlib[zpos++] = 0x01;  // zlib header (deflate, no compression)
    int offset = 0;
    while (offset < rawLen) {
        int blockLen = (rawLen - offset < maxBlock) ? (rawLen - offset) : maxBlock;
        bool last = (offset + blockLen >= rawLen);
        zlib[zpos++] = last ? 0x01 : 0x00;  // BFINAL + BTYPE=00 (stored)
        zlib[zpos++] = blockLen & 0xFF; zlib[zpos++] = (blockLen >> 8) & 0xFF;
        int inv = ~blockLen;
        zlib[zpos++] = inv & 0xFF; zlib[zpos++] = (inv >> 8) & 0xFF;
        memcpy(zlib + zpos, raw + offset, blockLen);
        zpos += blockLen;
        offset += blockLen;
    }
    // Adler32
    unsigned int a = 1, b = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < rawLen; i++) { a = (a + raw[i]) % 65521; b = (b + a) % 65521; }
    unsigned int adler = (b << 16) | a;
    zlib[zpos++] = (adler >> 24) & 0xFF; zlib[zpos++] = (adler >> 16) & 0xFF;
    zlib[zpos++] = (adler >> 8) & 0xFF; zlib[zpos++] = adler & 0xFF;
    writeChunk("IDAT", zlib, zpos);
    writeChunk("IEND", nullptr, 0);
    fclose(f);
    delete[] raw; delete[] zlib;
}

static void captureFramePNG(const char* filename, int w, int h) {
    unsigned char* px = new unsigned char[w * h * 4];
    glReadPixels(0, 0, w, h, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, px);
    writePNG(filename, w, h, px);
    delete[] px;
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK WndProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp) {
    switch (msg) {
        case WM_KEYDOWN:
            if (wp == VK_ESCAPE) { g_running = false; PostQuitMessage(0); return 0; }
            if (wp == VK_F1)    { g_showFPS = !g_showFPS; return 0; }   // v53: toggle FPS
            if (wp == VK_F2)    { g_manualCapture = true; return 0; } // v60: capture BMP
            if (wp == VK_F3)    { g_recording = !g_recording;
                                  if (g_recording) { Log("[Record] Started (frames → PNG)"); g_recordFrame = 0; }
                                  else Log("[Record] Stopped (%d frames)", g_recordFrame);
                                  return 0; } // v60: toggle recording
            if (wp == VK_F4)    { int n = g_shaders ? g_shaders->checkReload() : 0;
                                  if (n > 0) Log("[HotReload] %d shader(s) recompiled", n);
                                  else Log("[HotReload] No changes detected");
                                  return 0; } // v60: hot-reload shaders
            break;
        case WM_CLOSE: g_running = false; PostQuitMessage(0); return 0;
        case WM_SIZE: g_width = LOWORD(lp); g_height = HIWORD(lp); return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProc(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

static HWND createWindow(int w, int h) {
    // Регистрируем класс (игнорируем "уже зарегистрирован" — это нормально
    // если предыдущий экземпляр не снял класс).
    WNDCLASSEX wc = {};
    wc.cbSize = sizeof(WNDCLASSEX);
    wc.style = CS_OWNDC | CS_HREDRAW | CS_VREDRAW;
    wc.lpfnWndProc = WndProc;
    wc.hInstance = GetModuleHandle(nullptr);
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
    wc.hbrBackground = nullptr;
    wc.lpszClassName = "DemoRT";
    ATOM cls = RegisterClassEx(&wc);
    if (!cls && GetLastError() != 0x582) { // 0x582 = ERROR_CLASS_ALREADY_EXISTS
        Log("[Error] RegisterClassEx failed, err=0x%lx", GetLastError());
    }

    // WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW вместо WS_POPUP — даёт рамку, заголовок,
    // кнопку в taskbar. Надёжно видно на Windows 11.
    DWORD style = WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW | WS_VISIBLE | WS_CLIPSIBLINGS | WS_CLIPCHILDREN;
    DWORD exStyle = WS_EX_APPWINDOW | WS_EX_WINDOWEDGE;
    RECT rc = {0, 0, w, h};
    AdjustWindowRectEx(&rc, style, FALSE, exStyle);
    int cw = rc.right - rc.left;
    int ch = rc.bottom - rc.top;
    int sw = GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN), sh = GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN);
    int x = (sw - cw) / 2, y = (sh - ch) / 2;
    if (x < 0) x = 0;
    if (y < 0) y = 0;
    HWND hwnd = CreateWindowEx(exStyle, "DemoRT", "Demo Runtime v60", style,
        x, y, cw, ch,
        nullptr, nullptr, GetModuleHandle(nullptr), nullptr);
    if (hwnd) {
        Log("[Window] HWND=%p created at (%d,%d) size %dx%d (client %dx%d)",
            hwnd, x, y, cw, ch, w, h);
    }
    return hwnd;
}

static bool createGLContext(HWND hwnd) {
    g_hdc = GetDC(hwnd);
    PIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR pfd = {};
    pfd.nSize = sizeof(pfd); pfd.nVersion = 1;
    pfd.dwFlags = PFD_DRAW_TO_WINDOW | PFD_SUPPORT_OPENGL | PFD_DOUBLEBUFFER;
    pfd.iPixelType = PFD_TYPE_RGBA; pfd.cColorBits = 32; pfd.cDepthBits = 24;
    int pf = ChoosePixelFormat(g_hdc, &pfd);
    SetPixelFormat(g_hdc, pf, &pfd);
    HGLRC tmp = wglCreateContext(g_hdc);
    wglMakeCurrent(g_hdc, tmp);
    typedef HGLRC (WINAPI *PFN_wglCreateContextAttribsARB)(HDC, HGLRC, const int*);
    auto fn = (PFN_wglCreateContextAttribsARB)(void*)wglGetProcAddress("wglCreateContextAttribsARB");
    if (fn) {
        int attribs[] = {0x2091, 3, 0x2092, 3, 0x9126, 0x0001, 0x2094, 0, 0};
        HGLRC modern = fn(g_hdc, nullptr, attribs);
        if (modern) { wglMakeCurrent(nullptr, nullptr); wglDeleteContext(tmp); wglMakeCurrent(g_hdc, modern); g_hglrc = modern; }
        else g_hglrc = tmp;
    } else g_hglrc = tmp;
    if (!LoadOpenGLFunctions()) { Log("[Error] GL functions not loaded"); return false; }
    typedef BOOL (WINAPI *PFN_wglSwapIntervalEXT)(int);
    auto swi = (PFN_wglSwapIntervalEXT)(void*)wglGetProcAddress("wglSwapIntervalEXT");
    if (swi) swi(1);
    return true;
}

int WINAPI WinMain(HINSTANCE, HINSTANCE, LPSTR, int) {
    std::string smtPath = "demo.smt";
    std::string shaderDir = "shaders";

    Log("[Start] Demo Runtime — loading %s", smtPath.c_str());
    sm::Show show;
    try {
        show = sm::load(smtPath);
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        Log("[Error] Failed to load %s: %s", smtPath.c_str(), e.what());
        MessageBoxA(nullptr, ("Failed to load " + smtPath + ":\n" + e.what()).c_str(), "Demo", MB_ICONERROR);
        return 1;
    }
    Log("[OK] SMT loaded: duration=%.1fs, %d clips, %d segments",
        show.duration, (int)show.clips.size(), (int)show.segs.size());

    // Диагностика парсера: проверяем что opacity/progress непустые у каждого клипа.
    for (const auto& c : show.clips) {
        Log("  clip '%s' effect='%s' opacity_tokens=%d progress_tokens=%d uniforms=%d",
            c.id.c_str(), c.effect.c_str(),
            (int)c.opacity.size(), (int)c.progress.size(),
            (int)c.uniforms.size());
    }

    // Single-instance mutex — предотвращает двойной запуск (был виден в трейсе).
    HANDLE hMutex = CreateMutexA(nullptr, TRUE, "Global\\DemoRT_v51_SingleInstance");
    if (hMutex && GetLastError() == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) {
        Log("[Warn] Another instance is already running — exiting this one.");
        if (hMutex) CloseHandle(hMutex);
        return 0;
    }

    g_width = show.w; g_height = show.h;
    g_hwnd = createWindow(g_width, g_height);
    if (!g_hwnd) { Log("[Error] Window creation failed, err=0x%lx", GetLastError()); return 1; }
    if (!createGLContext(g_hwnd)) { Log("[Error] GL context failed"); return 2; }

    // Делаем окно видимым и активным.
    ShowWindow(g_hwnd, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
    UpdateWindow(g_hwnd);
    SetForegroundWindow(g_hwnd);
    SetFocus(g_hwnd);
    Log("[Window] Visible=true, foreground set");
    Log("[GL] %s / %s", glGetString(GL_RENDERER), glGetString(GL_VERSION));

    glx::ShaderCache shaders;
    g_shaders = &shaders;  // v60: make accessible from WndProc for F4 hot-reload
    shaders.init(shaderDir);
    glx::FBOPool fbos;
    fbos.init(g_width, g_height);

    int compiled = 0;
    for (const auto& c : show.clips) {
        if (c.effect != "finish" && c.effect != "-" && shaders.getProgram(c.effect)) compiled++;
    }
    Log("[OK] %d shader programs compiled", compiled);

    double startTime = getTime();
    int frameCount = 0;
    double lastDiag = 0.0;
    double prevT = 0.0;   // для dt (расчёт FPS)
    MSG msg = {};
    Log("[Loop] Entering render loop, duration=%.1fs", show.duration);
    Log("[Help] F1 = FPS | F2 = capture BMP | F3 = record PNG | F4 = hot-reload shaders");
    while (g_running) {
        while (PeekMessage(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) {
            if (msg.message == WM_QUIT) { g_running = false; break; }
            TranslateMessage(&msg); DispatchMessage(&msg);
        }
        if (!g_running) break;

        double T = getTime() - startTime;
        if (T >= show.duration) { Log("[Done] Show finished at T=%.2fs, frames=%d", T, frameCount); break; }

        try {
            glx::renderFrame(show, T, shaders, fbos);
        } catch (const std::exception& e) {
            Log("[Error] renderFrame exception at T=%.3f: %s", T, e.what());
            g_running = false;
            break;
        }

        // v60: Auto-capture at scene boundaries + 2s.
        if (g_captureIdx < 7 && T >= g_captureTimes[g_captureIdx]) {
            captureFrame(g_captureNames[g_captureIdx], g_width, g_height);
            Log("[Capture] Saved %s (%dx%d → 640x360)", g_captureNames[g_captureIdx], g_width, g_height);
            g_captureIdx++;
        }
        // v60: Manual capture on F2.
        if (g_manualCapture) {
            char fname[64];
            snprintf(fname, sizeof(fname), "shot_manual_T%03d.bmp", (int)T);
            captureFrame(fname, g_width, g_height);
            Log("[Capture] Manual: %s at T=%.2f", fname, T);
            g_manualCapture = false;
        }
        // v60: Recording — save every frame as PNG.
        if (g_recording) {
            char fname[64];
            snprintf(fname, sizeof(fname), "rec_%05d.png", g_recordFrame);
            captureFramePNG(fname, g_width, g_height);
            g_recordFrame++;
        }

        SwapBuffers(g_hdc);

        // v60: Frame limiter — cap at 60 FPS to prevent tearing and waste.
        // vsync in windowed mode on Win11/NVIDIA doesn't always work strictly.
        {
            static double s_lastFrameTime = 0.0;
            double now = getTime();
            double frameElapsed = now - s_lastFrameTime;
            double targetFrameTime = 1.0 / 60.0;  // 16.67 ms
            if (frameElapsed < targetFrameTime) {
                double sleepMs = (targetFrameTime - frameElapsed) * 1000.0;
                if (sleepMs > 1.0) Sleep((DWORD)(sleepMs - 0.5));  // 0.5ms bias for Sleep overhead
            }
            s_lastFrameTime = getTime();
        }

        frameCount++;

        // v53+v54: FPS calculation — накапливаем ВСЕГДА (для статистики),
        // окно обновляем только если F1 включён.
        double dt = T - prevT;
        prevT = T;
        g_fpsFrames++;
        g_fpsAccum += dt;
        if (g_fpsAccum >= 0.5) {
            g_fpsValue = (double)g_fpsFrames / g_fpsAccum;
            g_fpsFrames = 0;
            g_fpsAccum = 0.0;

            // v54: обновляем статистику (всегда).
            if (g_fpsSamples == 0) {
                g_fpsMin = g_fpsValue;
                g_fpsMax = g_fpsValue;
            } else {
                if (g_fpsValue < g_fpsMin) g_fpsMin = g_fpsValue;
                if (g_fpsValue > g_fpsMax) g_fpsMax = g_fpsValue;
            }
            g_fpsSum += g_fpsValue;
            g_fpsSamples++;

            // v60: Per-scene FPS tracking.
            for (int i = 0; i < g_numScenes; i++) {
                if (T >= g_scenes[i].start && T < g_scenes[i].end) {
                    if (g_fpsValue < g_scenes[i].minFps) g_scenes[i].minFps = g_fpsValue;
                    if (g_fpsValue > g_scenes[i].maxFps) g_scenes[i].maxFps = g_fpsValue;
                    g_scenes[i].sumFps += g_fpsValue;
                    g_scenes[i].samples++;
                    break;
                }
            }

            // Adaptive quality with hysteresis: switch to LOW when FPS < 28,
            // back to HIGH when FPS > 35. Prevents oscillation.
            if (g_fpsValue > 0) {
                static bool s_lastQuality = true;
                if (glx::g_qualityHigh && g_fpsValue < 28.0) {
                    glx::g_qualityHigh = false;
                    Log("[Quality] LOW (steps=24, FPS=%.1f)", g_fpsValue);
                } else if (!glx::g_qualityHigh && g_fpsValue > 45.0) {
                    glx::g_qualityHigh = true;
                    Log("[Quality] HIGH (steps=40, FPS=%.1f)", g_fpsValue);
                }
            }

            // v53: заголовок только когда F1 on.
            if (g_showFPS) {
                double avgSoFar = g_fpsSum / g_fpsSamples;
                snprintf(g_titleBuf, sizeof(g_titleBuf),
                    "Demo Runtime v60  |  %.1f FPS (min=%.1f max=%.1f avg=%.1f)  |  T=%.2fs  |  frames=%d  |  F1 toggle",
                    g_fpsValue, g_fpsMin, g_fpsMax, avgSoFar, T, frameCount);
                SetWindowTextA(g_hwnd, g_titleBuf);
            }
        }

        // v53: заголовок управляется transitions F1.
        {
            static bool s_prevShowFPS = true;
            if (g_showFPS != s_prevShowFPS) {
                s_prevShowFPS = g_showFPS;
                if (!g_showFPS) {
                    SetWindowTextA(g_hwnd, "Demo Runtime v60  -  ESC quit, F1 toggle FPS");
                }
            }
        }

        // Логируем 1-й кадр и затем каждые 5 секунд — подтверждает, что цикл жив.
        if (frameCount == 1) {
            Log("[Loop] First frame rendered, T=%.3fs", T);
            lastDiag = T;
        } else if (T - lastDiag >= 5.0) {
            Log("[Loop] T=%.2fs frames=%d", T, frameCount);
            lastDiag = T;
        }
    }
    Log("[Loop] Exited, total frames=%d", frameCount);

    // v54: финальная статистика FPS в trace.log.
    {
        double finalT = getTime() - startTime;
        if (g_fpsSamples > 0) {
            double avgFPS = g_fpsSum / g_fpsSamples;
            double theoreticalAvg = (finalT > 0.0) ? (double)frameCount / finalT : 0.0;
            Log("[Stats] FPS over %.2fs (%d samples @ 0.5s window):", finalT, g_fpsSamples);
            Log("  sampled:     min=%.2f  max=%.2f  avg=%.2f  FPS", g_fpsMin, g_fpsMax, avgFPS);
            Log("  theoretical: %d frames / %.2fs = %.2f FPS", frameCount, finalT, theoreticalAvg);
            Log("  range:       %.1f FPS (max-min = %.1f)", g_fpsMax - g_fpsMin, g_fpsMax - g_fpsMin);
            Log("  quality:     %s (nebula steps=%d)", glx::g_qualityHigh ? "HIGH" : "LOW", glx::g_qualityHigh ? 40 : 24);
            // v60: Per-scene FPS breakdown.
            Log("  per-scene:");
            for (int i = 0; i < g_numScenes; i++) {
                if (g_scenes[i].samples > 0) {
                    double avg = g_scenes[i].sumFps / g_scenes[i].samples;
                    double dur = g_scenes[i].end - g_scenes[i].start;
                    Log("    %-20s T=%5.0f-%5.0fs (%4.0fs)  min=%5.1f  max=%5.1f  avg=%5.1f  FPS  (%d samples)",
                        g_scenes[i].name, g_scenes[i].start, g_scenes[i].end, dur,
                        g_scenes[i].minFps, g_scenes[i].maxFps, avg, g_scenes[i].samples);
                }
            }
        } else {
            Log("[Stats] No FPS samples collected (show ended too quickly).");
        }
    }

    if (g_hglrc) { wglMakeCurrent(nullptr, nullptr); wglDeleteContext(g_hglrc); }
    if (g_hdc && g_hwnd) ReleaseDC(g_hwnd, g_hdc);
    if (g_hwnd) DestroyWindow(g_hwnd);
    if (hMutex) ReleaseMutex(hMutex);
    if (hMutex) CloseHandle(hMutex);
    Log("[Exit] Demo Runtime ended");
    return 0;
}
